item.title: Top security official says not yet responded to Vance’s letter; No new decision has been made regarding a change to nuclear doctrine
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council Major General Mohsen Rezaei has confirmed that he has not responded to a letter by US Vice President JD Vance yet, and there is no change in nuclear doctrine of the Islamic Republic of Iran.

item.title: Leader issues message on anniversary of Operation Zulfaqari in Abadan
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Leader of the Islamic Revolution Ayatollah Sayyid Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei has issued a message marking the anniversary of Operation Zulfaqari—the popular epic that drove the Ba'athist aggressors off Abadan Island— and highlighted the factors behind the Iranian triumph during the Sacred Defense (1980-88 Iran-Iraq War).

item.title: Iran will not abandon its seven conditions for deal with US, envoy says
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran will not back down from its seven conditions for an agreement with the United States, including an end to all wars in the region, its ambassador to Egypt, Mojtaba Ferdowsipour, said on Saturday, stressing that Tehran has no trust in Washington.
